recap.headline: Brandin Podziemski Is Haunting LeParth James
recap.subhead: LeParth James dumped Brandin Podziemski for Brice Sensabaugh, and Podziemski is now cooking him from inside the Nova Knicks lineup this week.

zingers.line: LeParth James cut Brandin Podziemski, who has 47 points and 10 threes since, and now has to beat him on Nova Knicks.
Tre Jones' 17 assists since arriving turned a 5-5 tie into 7-3 over Zero Fox Given; that pickup is the whole lead.
White Mambas cut De'Andre Hunter for Jordan Poole's 3-for-8 shooting, and Hunter is now putting up 30 points for MONSTARS.
Zero Fox Given is punting steals and points, then acts surprised sitting 3-8 with no points, no steals and no clue.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw left Daniel Gafford's 8 points on the bench and sit 3-8 with 10 starts left.
Gopher Gold leads theInfamous 7-3 and holds the starts-left deficit, 11 to 13, so the lead is shakier than it looks.
BrookynDynasty parked Kelly Oubre Jr.'s 8 points on the bench, then dropped 3-7 on the night to a team they lead 8-3.

night: Cooper Flagg, Suggs to be you: 34 PTS, 8 AST, 5 STL, 4 BLK. Zero Fox Given had no answer, and it showed in the night record, 2-7-2.
Neemias Queta of White Mambas posted 11 PTS and 22 REB on 4-8 shooting, and White Mambas still won the night 6-4-1 anyway.
LeParth James benched Derrick White, who scored 13, and left 25 points on the bench. The manager went 5-4-2 and will say it didn't matter.
Scoot Henderson dropped 18 PTS and 7 AST on 6-15 FG and is still on the wire. Dominick Barlow's 12 PTS, 8 REB are also sitting there.
White Mambas won the night 6-4-1 over Adam Silver Dez Nuts, and BrookynDynasty finished 3-7-1 against Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw.
